sources.supports: getBdd validates the case ID, places it as the only path segment and dispatches with responseKind 'text', which keeps the retry, rate-limit and timeout pipeline of a JSON read but reads the body as text. The method is documented as returning the feature file body, an empty string when the case has no scenario.
The text pipeline returns the raw response body without parsing it, so nothing between TestRail and the caller can alter the Gherkin.
get_bdd/{case_id} exports a case's BDD scenario as a .feature file and takes the case ID alone. Its response is the feature text itself rather than JSON.

input_policy.notes: Strictness is an MCP boundary requirement. The identifier is the only input; there is no query or body.

outer_result.notes: The only endpoint of this API that answers with text. The Gherkin is carried through unchanged, including an empty string for a case with no scenario, which is a real answer rather than an error. There is no entity schema to drift-check text against.

requirements.description: Reject unknown top-level fields before driver invocation rather than forwarding or discarding them.
Report a case with no scenario as the empty string the endpoint returns, rather than as an error or a null.

parameters.semantics: No coercion. The validated number is passed positionally and appears verbatim in the path.

wire.encoding: Decimal integer path segment; numeric strings are rejected rather than coerced.

upstream_response.text:
@APP-1
Feature: Users cannot login with invalid credentials

  Scenario: User cannot login with invalid password
    Given I have entered "invalid" into the password field
    When I click the login button
    Then I see I am not logged in
